whatItFakes: Opening generation records family for nearly every resident (99.9 to 100% with a relative, 3.6 to 4.9 links each, every link mutual; src/core2/opening-family-coverage.test.ts), against P10's 65% and 1.5. The relation-type and household mix is not yet validated against a published kinship source.
why: P10 reports only 6,481 of 10,001 residents have any recorded family, 1.5 family links per person, and 74 deaths reaching 57 relatives. These are P10 measurements, not rerun here.
replacement: Source-qualified kinship and summarized family histories with realistic relation-type and household coverage; validate actual event recipients. Coverage is measured in src/core2/opening-family-coverage.test.ts; counted deaths already reach relatives (counted-death-notices.test.ts).

whatItFakes: Inherited generator profiles repeat across unrelated residents instead of source-qualified person-keyed trait variation.
why: P10 reports 68 trait profiles for 10,001 residents and 1,198 residents sharing one profile; aggregate behavior repeats. These are P10 measurements. Resolved by P15 Part 1 (OPUS-PEOPLE, 2026-10-10): src/core2/opening-personality.ts gives each resident and relative a person-keyed temperament from NEO facet age and sex norms, a heritable share and registered dimension correlations; the Sacramento probe measured 2,135 distinct core profiles for 10,001 residents, the largest held by 75 (0.75%). The facet-to-dimension mapping is registered as SG-P15-personality-mapping.
replacement: Person-keyed WHO trait generation from real instrument spreads and covariance with provenance and checked population diversity; ongoing decisions remain reason-based.

whatItFakes: Every family connection receives the same opening closeness regardless of relation, shared home or recorded history.
why: P10 reports all family links opening at 0.46. CTO REVIEW 11 requires relation-specific and shared-home continuity. Resolved by P15 part 2 (OPUS-PEOPLE, 2026-10-10): opening closeness follows tie type, coresidence, distance and the childhood shared at home (openingClosenessHours in src/core2/closeness.ts); registered as SG-P15-closeness-model.
replacement: Source-qualified opening relation-strength priors from relation and co-residence records, checked against tie-strength evidence.

whatItFakes: A directory lookup satisfies company utility and can crowd out acting on a cause despite a relevant office already being known.
why: P10 reports 339 of 595 drive acts were lookups and no cause holder approached an office. CTO approves suppressing repeated lookups once a relevant office is known. Resolved by P15 part 4 (OPUS-PEOPLE, 2026-10-10): the look-up act answers a cause's need to know where to go, is offered only to people with a cause, and offers only the offices (with staff), meeting places and groups of a kind they know none of (office-directory in src/core2/modules/people.ts); company comes from people.
replacement: Knowledge-qualified directory offers and utility tied to actual information needs, with end-to-end ordinary cause/action evidence.

whatItFakes: Stress-derived safety utility favors organizing immediately after acute bereavement without a grief response favoring withdrawal and family.
why: P10 reports a widow organized on the day her husband died; CTO REVIEW 11 requires grief to first pull toward withdrawal and family. Resolved by P15 part 4 (OPUS-PEOPLE, 2026-10-10): a death gives each relative grief that pulls toward rest and contact with family and holds back organizing, fading by their own resilience line (src/core2/grief.ts); registered as SG-P15-grief-line.
replacement: A source-qualified evolving bereavement state and choice contributions that preserve variation, family context and actual later cause formation.

whatItFakes: Historical acquaintances are seeded for the player alone and carry no dated shared moments keyed to both people. Other residents have no generated acquaintance history for a reunion to read.
why: CTO REVIEW 12 reports P13 proof #3929: La Homa has only the player’s twenty faded school acquaintances and no recorded shared moment. This is a P13 finding, not independently rerun here. Resolved Oct 16, 2026 (core-standins-opening-deletions): by the two-level rule only the player's circle and people they meet carry history, and a person filled in later is seeded from the world; the shared-past generator for everyone is not built.
replacement: Generate source-qualified classmates, coworkers, neighbors and congregation acquaintances for everyone, with dated pair-keyed shared moments and realistic network spreads. Preserve genuine supplied shared history.

whatItFakes: Unconditional CEX service means become capped fictional household opening budgets with named counterparties. National component proportions scale regional/household-size parent categories. Equal initial vendor shares are recorded terms, not measured choice.
why: Source means do not establish individual needs, supplier scope, recurring bill dates, delivered services or a per-world person dispersion.
replacement: Use recorded individual budgets and product-compatible agreements plus matched service-level size/region priors and actor purchasing producers. Oct 23, 2026 research (research-opening-customers-sourced-parameters): the 60 regional and household-size parent means now carry their published 95 percent sampling intervals (BLS CEX Tables 1800 and 1400, calendar 2024), and openingCustomerSizeTopCode is that table's own last column ('Five or more people'), a lookup key rather than a threshold. openingCustomerPeriodMonths and openingCustomerAgreementLeadDays stay TUNABLE: they are calendar conventions and no published table gives these services' invoice cadence or the start dates of agreements running at the opening. Still faked: individual budgets, component shares within each parent and the equal vendor shares; a matched individual-level spending distribution (for example CE Interview microdata) and recorded purchasing producers would close it.

whatItFakes: Retrospective aggregate public-building spending, estimated cleaning/coverage fractions and saved fictional authority/appropriation produce bounded custodial budgets. The modeled source is not a real 2021 county or CDP appropriation.

replacement: The later public-budget, procurement and intergovernmental-transfers modules provide dated own-government authority, appropriation, award/agreement, price, supplier scope and actual source-owned payment calendar. Preserve actual county owner IDs and never invent a municipal budget for a census-designated place. Oct 23, 2026 research: openingCustomerPublicCleaningBudgetShare is ESTIMATED 0.124 (BOMA International 2012 cleaning share of operating cost 0.183 times the Census 2022 current-operations share 0.6754 of local general-public-buildings spending) and openingCustomerLocalAuthorityBudgetCoverage is ESTIMATED 0.80 (Census 2022: county, municipal and township governments make all of it, counties 0.4987; weighted by the share of playable places with their own government), read by buildOpeningCustomers in src/core2/opening-customers.ts; research files data/research/core/census-2022-local-public-buildings-by-government-type.json and data/research/core/building-operating-cost-janitorial-share.json, checked by scripts/research/check-opening-customer-priors.ts. A measured share of local public-building spending paid to custodial contractors would make the cleaning share SOURCED; reading each place's buyer government types against its state's county share is pool item core-opening-public-buyers-sourced-reads.

replacement: Open Oct 23, 2026: the thirteen openingEmployerCashBufferDays* rows were reopened against the JPMorgan Chase Institute PDF (same SHA256, Figures 6 and 7) and stay ESTIMATED: they are Chase-sample medians and quartiles of balance over ALL cash outflows, applied to generated employers whose outflow is planned payroll plus an IRS accounting-cost proxy. whatItFakes: A WHO-only stable per-firm startup cash-buffer rank and continuous quantile curve whose tail span is estimated from one drawn all-industries distribution. Published q25/median/q75 are real observations; the straight tail segments, endpoints and full CDF are estimates.

Never calibrate to future closures or wages surviving a requested year.

whatItFakes: Fresh generated public, institution, nonbusiness and unknown owners open with modeled zero-funded prototype journal cash pending genuine dated funding. The technical zero is not an observed zero balance and has no private-business calibration.
why: The superseded six-month payroll stock has no observed institutional balance, dated appropriation or funding receipt. Private JPMC employer/nonemployer cash evidence cannot supply those missing public or other unsupported owner facts.
replacement: Open Oct 23, 2026: a mechanic, not a number. The builder items that give these owners dated funding from a named payer on the journal are world-corporate-office-staff-never-paid (regional offices and other branch-or-institution owners), world-public-employer-staff-never-paid and world-town-public-works-staff-never-paid (town, state and national departments paid through their government's treasury); the row resolves when every owner in this branch is funded that way in a played year. What they must not read: the U.S. Census Bureau 2022 State and Local Government Finances Table 1 'Cash and security holdings' line (data/research/money/state-local-finances-2022.json, cashAndSecurityHoldings) equals its 'Insurance trust funds' line exactly ($5.60 trillion nationally, $5.41 trillion of it employee retirement), so it is pension, unemployment and workers' compensation trust assets, not an institution's or treasury's operating cash, and cannot seed an opening balance. Earlier replacement: REVIEW16 public-budget and national modules must supply genuine dated funding authority, appropriations and treasury/account receipts for represented institutions; other unsupported owners need separately source-qualified recorded funding. Preserve actual supplied balances. Never infer a measured zero, private JPMC reserve, survival stock or synthetic owner contribution.

whatItFakes: Carries a genuinely observed active 2017 county identity forward to the opening date using its official stable GID/PID alias and an already existing canonical county account. Intermediate identity-change history and actual opening active status remain unobserved.
why: The 2017 Census government listing was recorded before the January 1, 2021 opening; a later canonical directory cannot be backdated. Historical identity supplies an owner candidate, not legal powers, enacted appropriation or opening cash.
replacement: A dated opening government directory or independently sourced legal identity/change history matched to the same official government ID. Preserve the original 2017 observation date and account ID. Oct 23, 2026 research: the Census Government Units listing 2021 (units active as of fiscal year ending June 30, 2021, a year that contains the opening; posted January 28, 2022) carries every one of the 3,031 county governments of the 2017 listing with the same PID6, GID, county FIPS and state, all functionally active, and the 2022 Census of Governments counts 3,031 in the same states (data/research/core/census-gus-2021-county-identity-continuity.json). Reading that listing as the opening-dated observation, and comparing names without punctuation (one 2017 name lacks the apostrophe of its 2021 and 2025 names, so the current name match refuses it), is pool item core-opening-public-buyers-sourced-reads.

whatItFakes: Uses existing generated person countyIds and the observed 2020 county-to-place relation to qualify the represented share of a bounded opening purchase plan. Recorded geography and residency do not observe public demand, appropriation, custodial supplier reach, travel or delivery.

A verified geographic relation alone must not close the existing public-procurement appropriation/price stopgap. Oct 23, 2026 research: the county share of local general-public-buildings current operations per state (Census 2022 Census of Governments: Finance; national 0.4987, 10th to 90th percentile 0.243 to 0.807 among states with county governments, the five territories at the median) is in data/research/core/census-2022-local-public-buildings-by-government-type.json; bounding each county buyer's represented share by it is pool item core-opening-public-buyers-sourced-reads.
